rows.04:4794:
"...Now, put on these gloves and hit me, will you?"
With that, Akasaka pulled the gloves off his own hands.
They really were like a skeleton's hands.
Only the tendons of his fingers bulged out; it was as if skin alone were stuck to the bone.
"D-don't, Akasaka... I'm sorry, it was my fault."
Hatanaka couldn't move.
It was as if roots had sprouted from his feet; he couldn't take a single step.
And it wasn't just Hatanaka.
Not one of the guys there who had killed Akasaka could move.
"............"
Akasaka didn't answer.
Then he pulled off Hatanaka's gloves and put his own gloves on him instead.{p}
